The fuel filter is fitted in the engine bay:

  • 1.9 JTD on the bulkhead
  • 2.4 JTD on the intake chamber

It is cartridge type with a filter element (1) made up of a pack of paper discs with a filtering surface area of 5300 cm 2 and a filtration grade of 4- 5 mm.

The filter has a fuel pre-heating device (2) controlled by a thermal switch (3) fitted on the filter. When the temperature of the diesel is below 6° C an electrical resistance heats it up to a maximum of 15° C before sending it to the injection pump.

There is a plug (4), in the base of the fuel filter cartridge, for draining the water from the filter.

For EURO 3 versions:

  • for the 2.4 JTD too, the fuel filter is fitted on the flameproof bulkhead;
  • the fuel preheating device incorporates the fuel temperature sensor (which was previously fitted on the return manifold);
  • instead of the plug fitted at the base of the fuel filter cartridge, there is the water in fuel filter sensor.

Fuel filter
